question: What discharge capacities do the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% and with 50% Mn deliver?
rendered: According to Figure 4b in the document, the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% and with 50% Mn deliver discharge capacities of 212 mAh g−1 and 164 mAh g−1, respectively.
